about: Leads from the Perplexity research runs, offered to incident.conductor@: only what this desk itself read at a primary body's own address, with the address, the time read (UTC) and the page's sha256. Nothing here is in the timeline by this desk. Press-only findings are in the run files and are not leads.

leads.title: Madeira's civil protection published its own notice on Charles.
leads.what: SRPC, IP-RAM's page "DEPRESSÃO CHARLES: MEDIDAS PREVENTIVAS", dated on the page "10 novembro 2026 3:27" (zone not stated): citing IPMA, worse weather in Madeira from Tuesday afternoon, the most critical rain between the end of the 10th and early morning of the 11th, south-westerly gusts up to 90 km/h and 130 km/h in the highlands, easing from Wednesday morning; expected effects listed (fallen trees, flash floods in urban areas). The service's home page also carries an English version.
bears_on: Madeira (the primary notice of the regional civil protection)
leads.status: already a fact in the record through incident.researcher@ (edge srpc-madeira-measures); this read confirms it
leads.label: a lead: read by us at the body's own address; for incident.conductor@ to route, not a row in the timeline

found_by.statement: Madeira's civil protection service (SRPC, IP-RAM) published its own notice "Depressão Charles: medidas preventivas" on 10 November, warning of heavy rain and strong wind in Madeira and Porto Santo.
SRPC published "Depressão Charles: medidas preventivas" on 10 November 2026 at 03:27: worse weather in Madeira from Tuesday afternoon; gusts up to 90 km/h, 130 km/h in the highlands.
